user.title: Add Jooan CAM720
user.description: Enter the camera's IP and admin web password. The factory default is admin123. The talk-back token is read from the camera over the LAN; Jooan's cloud is not used.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the camera on the LAN.

init.title: Jooan CAM720 options
init.description: URL of the go2rtc build with CAM720 support, used for two-way talk.

talk.name: Talk to camera
talk.description: Play audio to the camera's speaker over the LAN.

media.name: Media
media.description: A media URL or file path ffmpeg can read.
